chapter: Jelly Roll's road trip, Benny Carter and Chick Webb
title: His first record with J. C. Johnson
summary: He again names J. C. Johnson as his first recording and they chat about composers being ripped off by publishers.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Now, had you -- when did you make your first record? When did you appear in a record for the first time?

Oh, my first record was back, way back. I remember this record I made with J. C., that's it, J. C. Johnson. That's what they called him, J. C. J. C. Johnson. Yes, he's a -- I understand he's living upstate someplace right now.
He's writing a book right now on how composers were ripped off.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, it's still happening. That'll always happen. These things happen as long as there're people.
Now, -- okay, so that's right, that was your first record. We'll get back to recording later on.
